parishInfo.name: San Lorenzo Ruiz Parish
parishInfo.parishPriest: Rev. Fr. Emmanuel M. De Guzman

officeHours.notes: Office transactions, document requests, and sacrament bookings are entertained strictly during regular office hours.

weekday.type: Novena to Our Mother of Perpetual Help & Holy Mass
Sacred Heart of Jesus Healing Mass & Holy Hour

confession.schedule: Every Wednesday and Friday at 4:30 PM - 5:15 PM (Before Mass); Every Saturday at 4:00 PM - 5:00 PM; or by appointment at the Parish Office for sick calls.
confession.location: Confessional Area near the Sacred Heart Shrine
confession.requirements: Contrite heart, examination of conscience, and sincere confession.

schedule.regularCommunityBaptism: Every Sunday at 10:30 AM (Pre-Baptismal Seminar on Saturday at 9:00 AM)
schedule.specialSoloBaptism: By appointment (Tuesday to Saturday mornings upon priest availability)

requirements: Photocopy of Child's PSA (Philippine Statistics Authority) or Local Civil Registrar Birth Certificate
Photocopy of Parents' Catholic Church Marriage Certificate (or Civil Marriage Contract / CENOMAR)
Parishioner Certificate or Barangay Clearance proving local residency
Official Godparent (Ninong/Ninang) Catholic Confirmation (Kumpil) Certificate (Must be at least 16 years old and practicing Catholic)
Attendance of Parents and Godparents at the Pre-Baptismal Seminar (Saturday 9:00 AM at the Parish Hall)
baptism.bookingNotice: Register at the Parish Office at least 1 to 2 weeks before the intended baptism date.

confirmation.schedule: Annual Parish Confirmation during the Parish Fiesta (September) or quarterly vicariate schedules.
requirements: Photocopy of PSA Birth Certificate
Original or Certified True Copy of Catholic Baptismal Certificate (marked 'For Confirmation Purposes')
Parish Catechetical Seminar Completion Certificate
Sponsor (Ninong/Ninang) Confirmation Certificate

holyMatrimony.schedule: Tuesdays to Saturdays (Morning slots: 9:00 AM, 10:30 AM; Afternoon slots: 2:00 PM, 3:30 PM). No regular weddings on Sundays or Good Friday.
holyMatrimony.bookingNotice: Apply and submit documentary requirements at least 2 to 3 months prior to wedding date to complete banns publication.
requirements: PSA Birth Certificate of Groom and Bride (Original & 2 photocopies)
PSA Certificate of No Marriage Record (CENOMAR) valid within 6 months
Newly issued Catholic Baptismal Certificate with annotation 'For Marriage Purposes' (Valid within 6 months)
Newly issued Catholic Confirmation Certificate with annotation 'For Marriage Purposes'
Pre-Cana / Marriage Preparation Seminar Certificate (2-day seminar conducted by Family and Life Ministry)
Canonical Interview with the Parish Priest (Scheduled after preliminary document review)
Publication of Marriage Banns in home parishes for 3 consecutive Sundays
Local Civil Registrar Marriage License (or Article 34 Affidavit of Cohabitation if living together for over 5 years)
Confession of Bride and Groom (1 or 2 days prior to the wedding mass)

anointingOfTheSick.availability: 24/7 on call for emergency cases / Viaticum; scheduled hospital and home blessings through the Parish Office.
anointingOfTheSick.instructions: Call the parish emergency mobile hotline immediately (+63 917 555 0199) or visit the office to request a priest.

funeralAndBlessing.funeralMass: Tuesday to Saturday at 1:00 PM or 2:30 PM (Must present Death Certificate and coordinate with cemetery/crematorium).
funeralAndBlessing.houseAndVehicleBlessing: Scheduled Tuesday to Saturday afternoons by appointment at the office.

types: Certificate of Good Moral Character / Parish Recommendation
requirements: Valid Government-Issued ID of the record owner (or authorization letter and ID of representative)
Approximate date/year of sacrament and full name of parents recorded in parish registry books

parishMinistries: Commission on Liturgy (Eucharistic Ministers of Holy Communion, Lectors & Commentators, Altar Servers)
Family and Life Ministry (Pre-Cana seminars, counseling, marriage enrichment)
Parish Youth Ministry (PYM - Youth fellowship, choir, outreach)
Social Action & Caritas Ministry (Poverty alleviation, feeding programs, calamity response)
Catechetical Ministry (Sunday school, baptism and confirmation formation)

frequentlyAskedQuestions.question: Can non-parishioners request sacraments or certificates?
frequentlyAskedQuestions.answer: Yes, but they must submit a Certificate of Permission / No Objection from their home parish priest for sacraments.

frequentlyAskedQuestions.question: What if my baptism was in another parish?
frequentlyAskedQuestions.answer: You must obtain your Baptismal Certificate directly from the specific parish where you were baptized, as sacramental registries are maintained by the church of origin.

frequentlyAskedQuestions.question: Are godparents required to be Roman Catholics?
frequentlyAskedQuestions.answer: Yes, canon law requires that at least one official godparent be a fully initiated, practicing Roman Catholic who has received Baptism, First Communion, and Confirmation.
